claims.scope: GaugeV2 reward accrual and distribution when total staked supply is zero

preconditions.text: Users call withdraw or withdrawAll to remove all staked tokens from the gauge, setting _totalSupply to zero.; Time passes without any deposits while the gauge total supply is zero.; During the empty period, notifyRewardAmount may be called by the distribution contract to add new rewards.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Reward emissions for a period should be accrued and remain claimable by users rather than being skipped when total supply is zero during that period.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Reward tokens are transferred to the contract but never become claimable by users; skipped rewards remain unaccrued and unclaimable even after new deposits and interactions.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: Reward tokens are transferred to the gauge contract for the empty period via notifyRewardAmount.
New deposits and user interactions occur after the empty period.
No attacker is required; harm arises from normal withdrawals and reward notifications.

limitations: Formalizes only v_rewards_stuck; other impacts (v_full_epoch_stuck, v_protocol_fund_loss) are handled in separate passes.
Claimability is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report states the observable outcome without a numeric accrual formula.
The empty-period reward notification is treated as a potential scenario per the report's 'may be called' wording.
